# 6 bed bungalow for sale

> Welcome to this spacious detached bungalow set on a private site in the peaceful countryside of Glanmire, offering an excellent balance of rural tranquillity and convenient access to nearby amenities. Extending to approximately 168 sq.m., this generously proportioned home offers flexible family accommodation with excellent potential for updating and modernisation throughout.
